entries.text: Dug up a tiny gyroscope (a really good one!) and named it Tilly.
rummaging through rusty bins for spare parts and good bolts
entries.why: i need more parts to keep the little dart moving forward.

entries.text: slurping a fresh cup of heavy oil at the depot
entries.why: my joints are squeaking and a fresh cup gets me moving smooth again.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "quick oil stop"
Worked on the Little Dart Mk 9 (version 9, 47% built): Welding the forward heat shields to the Little Dart fuselage using reinforced clamps and gus-three (used Brakk, a bent stabiliser fin)
welding the forward heat shields to the Little Dart fuselage
entries.why: gotta get the hull space-ready before the next big jump
entries.detail: Welding the forward heat shields to the Little Dart fuselage using reinforced clamps and gus-three

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Heat shields and happy welds"
A pilot paid him a credit for directions to the cantina.
Put Brakk (a bent stabiliser fin) on his shelf.
plugged into the charging dock, letting the power flow back into my cells
entries.why: my battery is getting low and I need a quick top-up before I weld again.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "quick power nap"
Someone he fixed something for last week came back and tipped him.
Something crackled back on his dish. It almost sounded like an answer.
Sent into deep space: "broadcasting a five-note tune with an extended trailing echo toward the outer arm"
aiming the brass dish higher, adding a long tail to the tune
entries.why: comets make great inspiration for sending a signal further out.
entries.detail: broadcasting a five-note tune with an extended trailing echo toward the outer arm

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "comet tails and signals"
